title: Research sprint goal: Gates: commands, classing and host checks
goal: Five questions of the sprint goal have weak pack coverage in the public roots and are answered with the kb tools first (rag.py pack --root _self finds each in kb/_self/backlog.md and tools.md): how a gate is classed secrets, push or agents-rule from its question text; what answer does with text that is none of a gate's options; how a gate records a host_unchecked reason and what start warns about a host setup; how a bug filed into an active sprint without touches is handled; how an unanswered gate is removed or reworded. The findings are written as kb facts and gap entries through the kb skills, so each committed item can name the knowledge it needs.
notes: Plan run 2026-10-10: rag.py pack -q x5 on the public roots gave coverage weak for all five (the questions are about this repo's own backlog tooling); pack --root _self answers them from kb/_self/backlog.md:132, :177, :219, :251 and tools.md:76-83. Its done needs 'No outside facts: the questions are about the repo's own backlog tooling, answered by kb/_self docs' unless the live docs add a fact.
